name: silentsum-rules-tests
description: Runs the Firestore and Storage security rules against the emulators. Needs Java and the Firebase CLI.

scripts.test:firestore: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-silentsum "npx jest firestore"

jest.//: One worker: both suites talk to the SAME emulator project, and each clears Firestore in beforeEach. Run in parallel they wipe each other mid-test.
